title: 스크롤 수면제 (발라드버전)
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a female vocalist. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic accents with palm-muted strums and occasional arpeggios. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the piano in a legato style. Drums enter with a standard backbeat on the snare and a steady kick pattern. The production features high-fidelity vocal processing with moderate plate reverb. The track is in the key of E Major with a tempo of 72 BPM in 4/4 time.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[sustained piano chords, clean electric guitar arpeggios]

[Verse 1]
[soft female vocals]
두 푸른 빛에 잠겼지 [piano melody continues]
이불 속 얼굴이 물들어
손끝이 멈추질 않아 [bass guitar enters]
스크롤 스크롤 끝이 없어
알림이 하나 둘 울리면
심장이 따라서 뛰잖아 [drums enter with soft kick and snare]
새벽 세 시야 벌써 눈이 따갑잖아
이불을 놓지 못해 [vocal swell]

[Chorus]
[full band arrangement, driving piano chords]
내려놔 내려놔 이 밤을
꺼져라 파란 불빛아
